---
title: "Predicted extinction risk"
---

::: {.disclaimer}
Everything on this site is a provisional, model based estimate. None of it is an IUCN
assessment, and none of it should be cited as a species' conservation status.
:::

Many described species have never been evaluated for the IUCN Red List, and many of
those that have been evaluated are listed as Data Deficient. Data Deficient does not
mean a species is safe. It means the evidence was not enough to decide. Species in
that position are generally left out of conservation planning for reasons that have 
nothing to do with their actual risk.

This site holds model based predictions of extinction risk for those species. The
methods come from published work, principally IUCNN.

```{=html}
<div id="release"></div>
<script>
fetch('data/release.json').then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
  const el = document.getElementById('release');
  if (!d.n_species) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No predictions published yet. ' +
      'Run <code>build.R</code> once prediction files exist.</div>';
    return;
  }
  el.innerHTML = '<p><strong>' + d.n_species.toLocaleString() + '</strong> species across <strong>' +
    d.n_groups + '</strong> groups, from <strong>' + d.n_models + '</strong> models. ' +
    'Release ' + d.version + ', ' + d.date + '.</p>';
}).catch(() => {
  document.getElementById('release').innerHTML =
    '<div class="empty">No data yet. Run <code>build.R</code>.</div>';
});
</script>

<div class="filters">
  <input id="q" type="text" placeholder="Search a scientific name" style="min-width:320px">
</div>
<div id="quick"></div>

<script>
let INDEX = [];
fetch('data/index.json').then(r => r.json()).then(d => { INDEX = d; });

document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input', function () {
  const term = this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const box = document.getElementById('quick');
  if (term.length < 3) { box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const hits = INDEX.filter(s => s.species.toLowerCase().includes(term)).slice(0, 15);
  if (!hits.length) { box.innerHTML = '<p>Nothing found.</p>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML = '<ul>' + hits.map(s =>
    '<li><a href="species.html?id=' + s.id + '"><em>' + s.species + '</em></a> ' +
    '<span style="color:#667">' + s.group + '</span></li>').join('') + '</ul>';
});
</script>
```

## How to use this

The [priority list](priority.qmd) ranks species by how likely the models think they are
to be threatened.

[Browse](browse.qmd) filters the whole database. [Groups](groups.qmd) reports how each
model performed on species that do have assessments.

Each species page shows every prediction made for that species. We highlight instances
where models disagree.
